VERDICT: LGTM

The addition follows the mapper's established pattern exactly. `toSelfLink` is one more `default` derivation method sitting alongside the existing read-only derived fields (`toDisplayName`, `toTelephoneDisplay`, `toAgeBand`, etc.), wired via the same `@Mapping(target = ..., expression = "java(toX(owner))")` idiom, with matching javadoc style and the same `null`-when-absent convention used by its siblings. Logic lives in the right unit (DTO derivation belongs in the mapper), nothing is duplicated, and the openapi.yml schema entry mirrors the neighboring read-only properties. A maintainer of this codebase would find it natural.
